interface.longDescription: Installable Tanaab skills and supporting canon for consistent project, code, documentation, and delivery workflows.
defaultPrompt: Use $tanaab-project-milestone-planner to assess the current milestone, identify coverage gaps, and recommend a conservative task set.
Use $tanaab-project-milestone-author to draft an exact verified milestone update after the desired plan is approved.
Use $tanaab-task-decomposer to decide whether tanaabased/example#12 should remain intact, split into child tasks, or become a project milestone.
Use $tanaab-task-author to draft one canonical GitHub task from the available evidence without publishing it yet.
Use $tanaab-project-optimizer to audit a project's checked-in repository surfaces against applicable Tanaab optimization facets and produce a staged read-only improvement plan.
Use $tanaab-javascript-author to add Bun-run tests for TypeScript utility functions in utils/.
Use $tanaab-javascript-repo-standardizer to standardize a JavaScript and TypeScript Bun workspace monorepo, including package boundaries, formatting, type-checking, and baseline scripts.
Use $tanaab-github-workflow-author to create a Tanaab-approved GitHub Actions release workflow.
Use $tanaab-readme-author to tighten a repository README around its primary user journey while preserving complete reference material.
Use $tanaab-release-author to prepare a GitHub Release draft from CHANGELOG.md entries.
